proposals.evidence: DEDR 1942 explicitly lists Tamil/Malayalam keṭṭa and Kannada keṭṭa bad or spoiled, beside the ruin/spoil verb. The selected adjective and neuter forms fit these attested senses; negative phrases meaning not good and unrelated loan adjectives are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
